note: Town of Russell (Bayfield County) campground at Little Sand Bay on Lake Superior, ~15 min north of Bayfield, inside the Apostle Islands National Lakeshore (the National Park Service contact station and marina across the road are separate). Sand swim beach, boat ramp and harbor docks; tent sites 40-47 are the lakeside ones. Electric pedestals are shared between two sites. --Claude
